name: assimilation/harness/pi
description: Orchestrate babysitter SDK integration into Pi Coding Agent (pi CLI). Pi is the upstream Pi Coding Agent with CLI command `pi`. It shares the adapter codebase with oh-my-pi but has its own CLI, env vars (PI_SESSION_ID, PI_PLUGIN_ROOT), discovery entry, invoker entry, plugin structure, and distribution. Uses a loop-driver mechanism (agent_end + followUp) and in-process event handling rather than sh
